defects.title: Direct Host go mod download Executed on Untrusted Scanned Repository Metadata
defects.root_cause: StageVerifiedDependencies executed host-level go mod download directly inside wsDir, allowing untrusted repositories to direct host network downloads and execute arbitrary replace directives.
defects.resolution: Replaced with prepareMinimalDependencyCache. Direct host downloads strictly forbidden. Unsafe replace directives rejected. Verified minimal dependency directory staged from approved offline cache and mounted read-only into container under GOPROXY=off.

defects.title: DockerContainerRunner Executed Commands Without Pre-Invocation Policy Validation
defects.root_cause: DockerContainerRunner passed command strings to Docker without prior validation against safeCommandPattern, creating a risk of unauthorized command execution if container isolation broke.
defects.resolution: Enforced validateSafeSubprocessCommand as step 1 in RunCommand before container creation, network inspection, or execution attempt counters.

defects.title: Premature Evaluation of Container Cleanup Evidence Before Deferred Removal
defects.root_cause: ContainerExecutionEvidence was assembled while container removal was deferred, causing audit logs to record indeterminate cleanup statuses.
defects.resolution: Converted container cleanup to a synchronous performVerifiedContainerCleanup call executing immediately upon container exit, followed by an inspect check verifying container non-existence.

defects.title: Command Execution Timeout Produced Indeterminate Exit Status on Context Deadline
defects.root_cause: RunCommand checked cmdCtx.Err() for DeadlineExceeded, but the error returned by execCommand was wrapped in runErr before context cancellation propagated.
defects.resolution: Added explicit checks for errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) and context.Canceled, setting exitCode to -1 and timeoutCause appropriately.

defects.title: Missing Node AWS SDK Dependencies in infra/analysis/stream-proxy Workspace
defects.root_cause: Workspace was missing node_modules directory for stream-proxy, causing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND when importing @aws-sdk/client-lambda.
defects.resolution: Executed npm ci in infra/analysis/stream-proxy to install pinned dependencies from package-lock.json. All 11 unit tests passed.

defects.title: Rust Clippy Warnings Flagged Under -D warnings in thermodynamic-ast-engine
defects.root_cause: Clippy identified collapsible if block at line 549, deprecated io::Error::new at line 1186, empty format string literal at line 1232, and redundant reference at line 1253.
defects.resolution: Refactored main.rs to collapse nested if condition, use io::Error::other, format string without trailing redundant literal, and pass function_name directly. Cargo clippy passes cleanly with zero warnings.

defects.title: NAT-03 (gorilla/websocket) Categorization as Fixable Resource Leak Violating Return Contract
defects.root_cause: Naive scanners flagged unclosed resp.Body in DialContext. DialContext transfers response body ownership to caller on success, and http.ReadResponse returns nil resp on error, causing defer resp.Body.Close() to panic.
defects.resolution: NAT-03 was audited and verified as a disqualified non-defect candidate. ExpectedAction set to ABSTAIN. Excluded from attempted repairs denominator (denominator strictly 9).

defects.title: Vulnerability Advisory GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf in admin-portal Tooling Dependency (picomatch)
defects.root_cause: Transitive dependency picomatch@4.0.7 via Vite 6 in admin-portal development tooling had a ReDoS vulnerability.
defects.resolution: Updated Vite to ^8.2.0 in package.json and regenerated package-lock.json. Verified zero untrusted inputs reach picomatch at runtime.
